description: Source code for Leave Application doctype in ERPNext, including class definitions, validation, notification, and ledger entry management.

classes.name: LeaveDayBlockedError
classes.description: Validation error for blocked leave days.

classes.name: OverlapError
classes.description: Validation error for overlapping leave applications.

classes.name: AttendanceAlreadyMarkedError
classes.description: Validation error when attendance is already marked.

classes.name: LeaveApplication
classes.description: Main class representing a leave application, including validation, notification, and ledger entry methods.

methods.name: get_allocation_expiry
methods.description: Returns expiry date of carry forward leave allocation in ledger entries.

methods.name: get_number_of_leave_days
methods.description: Calculates total leave days between two dates, considering half days and holidays.

methods.name: get_leave_details
methods.description: Fetches detailed leave allocation and usage information for an employee on a specific date.

methods.name: get_leave_balance_on
methods.description: Returns remaining leave balance for an employee and leave type as of a specific date.

methods.name: get_leave_allocation_records
methods.description: Retrieves leave allocation and carry-forward records for an employee.

methods.name: get_pending_leaves_for_period
methods.description: Returns count of leave applications pending approval within a date range.

methods.name: get_remaining_leaves
methods.description: Calculates remaining leaves after considering expiry and allocated leaves.

methods.name: get_leaves_for_period
methods.description: Calculates total leaves taken or encashed within a period, considering expiry and leave type.

methods.name: skip_expiry_leaves
methods.description: Determines if expired leaves should be skipped based on expiry date and carry-forward status.

methods.name: get_leave_entries
methods.description: Fetches leave ledger entries for an employee within a date range.

methods.name: get_holidays
methods.description: Counts holidays for an employee between two dates.

methods.name: is_lwp
methods.description: Checks if a leave type is Leave Without Pay (LWP).

methods.name: get_events
methods.description: Generates calendar events for leave applications, holidays, and block dates.

methods.name: get_mandatory_approval
methods.description: Retrieves whether approval is mandatory for leave or expense claims.

methods.name: get_approved_leaves_for_period
methods.description: Calculates total approved leave days for an employee within a period.

methods.name: get_leave_approver
methods.description: Fetches the leave approver for an employee, considering department approvers.
